summary.en: Quantum Ventures Korea (퀀텀벤처스코리아) is a Seoul-based VC founded in October 2017 by Kim Hak-gyun (current KVCA chairman). It invests in Fourth-Industrial-Revolution core technologies — including AI semiconductors — and bio-healthcare. It is best known as an early, large backer of AI-chip unicorn FuriosaAI, into which it invested a reported total of about 160억원 starting at a sub-10억원 valuation. AUM was ~2,105억원 as of early 2022.

summary.en: FuturePlay (퓨처플레이) is a Seoul-based deep-tech accelerator and early-stage VC founded in 2014, regarded as one of Korea's largest accelerators by capital (~1,000억원 reported). It specializes in robotics, autonomous driving, AI, sensors, and aerospace, and has backed 170+ startups including Seoul Robotics, LiDAR maker SOS LAB, and KOSDAQ-listed space-launch company Innospace. It is a designated TIPS operator (named 'TIPS Operator of the Year' in 2025).

summary.en: Bluepoint Partners (블루포인트파트너스) is a Korean deep-tech accelerator and seed VC founded in 2014, with offices in Seoul (Gangnam) and Daejeon (Tech Valley). It backs science- and engineering-based founders in biotech, cleantech, materials, AI, and industrial/hardware tech, has supported ~140 startups (8 exits as of 2026), and pursued a KOSDAQ listing as one of Korea's first publicly listed accelerators. Notable portfolio: Tomocube, Nota AI.

summary.en: Ascendo Ventures (어센도벤처스) is a Seoul-based VC founded in 2017 that positions itself as a stage-agnostic lifecycle partner and has shifted its portfolio to roughly 90% deep tech over five years. It invests in industrial AI, robotics, advanced materials, energy and digital health, and has opened Daejeon and Busan offices since 2023 to source regional deep-tech deals. It has invested in 46+ companies (incl. WithRobot, Enerzai, Alsemy, Grinergy) with KRX IPO exits LIVSMED and ROKIT Healthcare.

summary.en: Innopolis Partners (이노폴리스파트너스) is an LLC-type, incubation-oriented VC founded in 2006 that specializes in public-technology commercialization and deep tech — semiconductors, advanced materials, aerospace, biotech and robotics — anchored in Korea's Daedeok/Daejeon science cluster. It manages 9 funds totaling 4,000억원+ cumulatively (including the 800억원 Daeduk Fund I), backs 130+ companies (incl. semiconductor firms Hana Materials, LB Semicon, and space-launch firm Perigee Aerospace), and is a leading TIPS / ScaleUp TIPS operator.

strategy.thesis: Korean venture capital firm with a deep-tech emphasis; its leadership notes that Korea has only 'tens of companies' in deep-tech categories mature enough to attract the country's largest VCs.

people.name: Nina Jung (정나라)
people.role: Investment Director (former KVIC executive; in VC since 2007)

summary.en: NextG Investment (넥스트지인베스트먼트) is a Seoul-based VC with a deep-tech investment emphasis. Investment Director Nina Jung, a former KVIC executive in the local VC industry since 2007, has noted that Korea has only 'tens of companies' in deep-tech categories mature enough to draw the country's largest VCs. Public details on fund size, founding year, and portfolio are limited.
summary.local: 넥스트지인베스트먼트는 딥테크 투자에 중점을 둔 서울 기반 VC다. 한국벤처투자(KVIC) 출신이자 2007년부터 국내 VC 업계에서 활동한 정나라 투자이사는 한국에 국내 대형 VC가 투자할 만큼 성숙한 딥테크 기업이 '수십 개' 수준에 불과하다고 진단했다. 펀드 규모·설립 연도·포트폴리오 등 공개 정보는 제한적이다.

sources.title: Korean VC investors expect national AI agenda to reshape their industry

name.en: System Semiconductor Fund (Korea Growth Investment Corp / Samsung-SK Hynix)

strategy.thesis: Government / corporate co-funded fund-of-funds program (anchored by Korea Growth Investment Corp with capital from Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix) that backs domestic small and mid-sized system-semiconductor (fabless) companies through selected VC operators, supporting M&A, marketing and overseas expansion.

program.eligibility: Domestic system-semiconductor / fabless companies with global competitiveness.

application.how_to_apply: Capital flows to startups via the selected VC operators (G.U. Investment, P&P Investment); not a direct-apply program.

summary.en: The System Semiconductor Fund (시스템반도체 펀드) is a Korean government/corporate co-funded fund-of-funds backing domestic fabless / system-semiconductor companies. Its first phase (~1,000억원, with mother-fund contributions of 500억원 from Samsung Electronics, 300억원 from SK Hynix and 200억원 from Korea Growth Investment Corp) deployed 500억원 through two selected operators — G.U. Investment (300억원) and P&P Investment (200억원) — chosen via a 3.5:1 competition.
summary.local: 시스템반도체 펀드(시스템반도체상생펀드)는 국내 팹리스·시스템반도체 기업을 지원하는 정부·기업 공동 출자형 모자펀드다. 1기는 약 1,000억원 규모로, 모펀드에 삼성전자 500억원·SK하이닉스 300억원·성장금융 200억원이 출자됐으며, 3.5:1 경쟁을 거쳐 선정된 지유투자(300억원)·피앤피인베스트먼트(200억원) 2개 운용사를 통해 500억원을 집행했다.
